# Vendor / reference material (IEEE)

Reference bundles for the conference paper. Day-to-day builds use `paper/IEEEtran.cls` and `paper/IEEEtran.bst` next to `shortpaper.tex`.

| Path | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `IEEE-conference-template-062824/` | Official IEEE conference LaTeX template (Jun 2024). |
| `IEEEtranBST2/` | IEEEtran BibTeX styles (`.bst`), example `.bib` files, HOWTO. |

Do not edit these trees for manuscript work; change `paper/shortpaper.tex` instead.
